text:
Defeated by a mere mortal?
How is this possible?
zh:
竟败给一介凡人？
这怎么可能？

text:
We have devoured countless souls to become gods.
Even more! We became gods able to walk upon this realm.
zh:
我们吞噬了无数灵魂，方才成神。
不止如此！我们成了能行走于此界的神明。

text:
And still, I am now kneeling in front of a mortal.
A pitiful display.
zh:
可如今，我却跪在一个凡人面前。
何其可悲。

text: My friends, I failed to protect our ultimate creation.
zh: 吾友们，我未能守住我们的终极造物。
